label: Timer
description: Schedules timeout and interval callbacks and cancels outstanding work on disposal.

setTimeout.description: Schedules a function listener or controller command string once after the requested delay.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.description: Callback function or controller command string.

setInterval.description: Schedules a function listener or controller command string repeatedly at the requested interval.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.description: Callback function or controller command string.

dispose.description: Cancels all pending timeouts and active intervals owned by this Timer instance. Repeated disposal is safe.

returns.description: Undefined after tracked timers have been cleared.
